d: Is Europe heading towards a direct confrontation with Russia? Moscow has raised the nuclear stakes, with former Russian President Dmitry Medvedev outlining circumstances that could justify a preventive nuclear strike. Meanwhile, Russian drones and aircraft have repeatedly tested NATO's airspace, raising fears of a wider conflict. Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov has warned that any European attack on Russia would trigger a very different war.
